title: Let's Learn English Lesson 30
subtitle: Rolling on the River
attribution: Source: VOA Learning English – Let's Learn English Level 1, Lesson 30: Rolling on the River (learningenglish.voanews.com). Public domain. This unofficial study helper is not affiliated with VOA.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hello! Washington, D.C. sits on the Potomac River. This river is important to the history and culture of the city. Today, I am at an outdoor seafood market near the Potomac River. Some say it is the oldest outdoor seafood market in the United States! I am here to buy seafood. Let's see what they have!
dialogue.zh: 嗨！华盛顿特区坐落在波托马克河上。这条河对这座城市的历史和文化很重要。今天我在波托马克河附近的一个露天海鲜市场。有人说这是美国最古老的露天海鲜市场！我来买海鲜。我们看看他们有什么！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Excuse me. Can you help me?
dialogue.zh: 打扰一下。你能帮我吗？

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Sure! What do you need?
dialogue.zh: 当然！你需要什么？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Pete!
dialogue.zh: 皮特！

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Anna!
dialogue.zh: 安娜！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: What are you doing here?
dialogue.zh: 你在这儿干什么？

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: I work here. You know, it's not easy to be a writer.
dialogue.zh: 我在这儿工作。你知道，当作家不容易。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yeah, I heard that. Sorry.
dialogue.zh: 嗯，我听说了。抱歉。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: But this job is great. I work outside by the river. And I can eat all the free seafood I want!
dialogue.zh: 不过这份工作很棒。我在河边户外工作。还能想吃多少免费海鲜就吃多少！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: That is great, Pete. In fact, I am here to buy some seafood for my dinner party.
dialogue.zh: 那很好，皮特。其实，我是来为晚宴买海鲜的。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: You came to the right place. They have the freshest seafood in town. How much money can you spend?
dialogue.zh: 你来对地方了。他们有全城最新鲜的海鲜。你能花多少钱？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I can only spend $50.
dialogue.zh: 我只能花 50 美元。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Okay. What do you want?
dialogue.zh: 好。你想要什么？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: First, I want to buy some shrimp.
dialogue.zh: 首先，我想买一些虾。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Sure thing. Follow me. How much shrimp do you want?
dialogue.zh: 没问题。跟我来。你要多少虾？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: How much do I need for five people?
dialogue.zh: 五个人需要多少？

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Give her a pound of shrimp!
dialogue.zh: 给她一磅虾！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Ok, now I want to buy some crabs.
dialogue.zh: 好，现在我想买一些螃蟹。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: The crabs here are delicious! They are the best because they come from the nearby Chesapeake Bay! Walk this way.
dialogue.zh: 这儿的螃蟹很好吃！它们最好，因为来自附近的切萨皮克湾！这边走。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: How many crabs do you want?
dialogue.zh: 你要多少只螃蟹？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I want a dozen crabs.
dialogue.zh: 我要一打螃蟹。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: You should get the larger crabs. They have the most meat.
dialogue.zh: 你该买大一点的螃蟹。它们肉最多。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Then I want a dozen large crabs, please!
dialogue.zh: 那我要一打大螃蟹，谢谢！

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Is that everything you need?
dialogue.zh: 这些就是你需要的全部吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Let's see … I have shrimp and crabs. And a friend is bringing a salad and many ears of corn-on-the-cob.
dialogue.zh: 我看看……我有虾和螃蟹。还有个朋友会带沙拉和很多玉米棒。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Is that all the seafood that you need?
dialogue.zh: 海鲜就这些了吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yes.
dialogue.zh: 是的。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: That'll be $49.95. Cash or credit?
dialogue.zh: 一共 49.95 美元。现金还是信用卡？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Credit, please.
dialogue.zh: 信用卡，谢谢。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Anna, you love to eat seafood. Did you grow up on the water?
dialogue.zh: 安娜，你很爱吃海鲜。你是在水边长大的吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: No, I didn't. But I love the water. And I love being on the water.
dialogue.zh: 不是。不过我喜欢水。也喜欢待在水上。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: You know how to sail?
dialogue.zh: 你会驾驶帆船？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Well … this afternoon I am going on a boat.
dialogue.zh: 嗯……今天下午我要上船。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: You are full of surprises. What kind of boat? Is it a motorboat or a sailboat?
dialogue.zh: 你真让人意外。什么样的船？是摩托艇还是帆船？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: It's a special boat, Pete. Well, thanks for your help. See you later!
dialogue.zh: 是一艘特别的船，皮特。好，谢谢你的帮助。再见！

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: See you, Anna! Wow, Anna's a sailor! Who knew?
dialogue.zh: 再见，安娜！哇，安娜是水手！谁能想到？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yes, rivers are important to the history and culture of Washington, D.C. And now I am part of this city's interesting waterfront culture. Until next time!
dialogue.zh: 是的，河流对华盛顿特区的历史和文化很重要。现在我也成了这座城市有趣的滨水文化的一部分。下次见！

quiz.prompt: How much money can Anna spend?
How much shrimp does Pete tell them to give Anna?
How many crabs does Anna buy?
